name: red-audience-safety-park
title: DRAFT Auto: Red Audience Safety (Leave + Park, unmeasured)
description: DRAFT safety auto, 2026-11-21. No shooting: leave the start area and park. Red frame: left side on the audience wall, facing -X (toward the red wall), back edge exactly on the centre line. Drive up the red side and park with only the front-right corner (about 3 x 3 in) inside the red loading zone and nothing touching a wall. No delay. Blue mirror (BlueFarSafetyParkAutonomous): far wall on the left, facing blue, park with one corner in the blue loading zone. The preload stays in the robot.

pose.provenance: DERIVED from the measured 396 x 374 mm chassis (15.591 x 14.724 in, robot.json). Facing -X (toward the red wall), left side on the audience wall (y = -72 + 14.724 / 2 = -64.638) and the BACK edge exactly on the centre line (x = -15.591 / 2 = -7.796, so the back edge is at 0.000 and not over it); the team confirmed this placement. robot.json's expanded length equals the chassis length, and the depollinator is stowed and never deployed here. Blue mirror (Blue Far): (7.796, 64.638, 0 deg). Assumes the Pinpoint tracking point is the chassis centre (robot.json caveat).

steps.notes: Leave diagonally off the audience wall to (-56.2, -50), then straight up the red side holding heading (facing the red wall, so the second leg is a strafe). End pose (-56.2, 19.638, 180 deg): the front edge is at x = -64.0, 8.0 in from the red wall, and the robot stops just south of the loading zone with only its front-right corner (-64.0, 27.0) inside it: a 3.00 x 3.00 in square. Blue mirror (56.2, -19.638, 0 deg).
